name: Machine Learning Systems Engineering
description: Introduction to machine learning systems engineering, data engineering for machine learning, model development and training, model deployment and serving. Monitoring and observability, security and privacy, responsible AI, DevOps for machine learning (MLOps), scaling and optimization. Practice assignments using tools and technologies like: TensorFlow, PyTorch, Docker, Kubernetes, MLflow, cloud AI platform (of choice).
